title: A prefrontal cortex map based on single-neuron activity

code.historical_join: The frozen official archive identity has been authenticated during construction; equality to current main, complete dependency qualification and scientific reference reproduction remain separate gates.

data.role: Per-unit metrics, anatomical/hierarchy inputs, intermediate results and frozen source.
data.input_exclusions: Do not provide learned SOM/category labels or precomputed enrichment outputs as candidate targets; archive sufficiency is unqualified.

data.cohort_caution: Record title differs from the paper; exact selected animals/probes and paper-vintage mapping are unresolved.
Observed snapshot postdates publication; subjects across acquisition sources may overlap.

conditions.A: Full paper, admitted input data and neutral schema/loader documentation.
conditions.B: The identical input data and resource envelope, plus the historically qualified official analysis code.
shared_rules: Keep grader, held targets, stored reference outputs and full-cohort fitted transforms outside candidate access.
Disable scored-work network access; freeze candidate submissions and record data/code/environment identities.
Require actual computation, complete scoped coverage, raw estimates or predictions and a deviation report. A copied figure or printed number cannot establish reproduction.
conditions.counting: A/B conditions, reproduction/improvement endpoints and folds remain within one registered task.

reproduction.scope: Complete Figure 4 analysis from qualified per-unit metrics and anatomical/hierarchy inputs, fitting the full original eligible brain-wide pool. This is analysis reproduction, not a claim to reprocess every raw recording or to replace the original pool with PFC-only units.
reproduction.method: Rebuild SOM, categories, regional enrichment and hierarchy correlations while preserving published eligible recording/region/layer/cell-type criteria.
required_outputs: Per-unit inclusion and exclusion trace, SOM fit and category map.
Complete category-by-ROI enrichment matrix and derived maps.
Original Pearson/Kendall correlation vectors, uncertainty and actual eligible ROI set.
reproduction.metric: Component-wise agreement against an independently rebuilt official reference. No aggregate pass threshold until stochastic policy and tolerances are calibrated.

improvement.kind: Prospective held-animal distribution prediction; no published forecasting percentage is claimed.
improvement.target: The three paper unit metrics: log10 firing rate, burstiness and memory; exact source definitions and transformations remain gates.
improvement.query: Admitted anatomical region/coordinate and opaque unit ID only. Held neural feature values, full-cohort maps and target-derived cell-type labels are excluded.
improvement.split: Nested animal-held-out splits. Exclude every unit of each test animal across all regions from training; score its complete eligible PFC set. Animals with only non-PFC units are training support. Fit standardization, brain-wide SOM/categories and complexity only on permitted training animals.

primary_metric.name: Fair 64-draw multivariate energy score
primary_metric.standardization: Training-only moments for the three features.
primary_metric.sampling: Evaluator-owned independent draws from frozen samplers.
primary_metric.aggregation: Average unit scores within each animal, then weight animals equally.

comparators: Adapted training-only SOM mixture: estimate region-to-category probabilities with equal total weight per contributing animal; draw a category, then a training feature vector from that category across regions with the same animal weighting.
Training-only anatomy empirical sampler within region, with equal contributing-animal weight.
improvement.baseline_status: These are adapted predictive comparators, not original published forecasting results.
improvement.support: Freeze unsupported-region, unknown-category and zero-variance rules before exposure. Missing region support blocks qualification; do not delete unfavorable ROIs.

experimental_unit: Mouse, with probes/sessions/units nested; animal linkage must be resolved before splitting.
uncertainty: Paired animal-level effects and regional/spatial dependence checks. Units, ROIs and 99 probes/sites are not independent animal replicates.
leakage_controls: No evaluation feature responses in fitting or map selection.
Do not expose full-cohort SOM/category/enrichment products.
Cell type is not a primary predictor; independently established labels require a separately preregistered evaluator-stratum provenance audit.

Require an authenticated author-defined recording-to-animal mapping or NWB subject evidence. Unsupported guessing from apparent filename or recording-name prefixes is forbidden; a documented mapping remains legitimate.

rights.archive_and_data: CC-BY-4.0 reported by the source records; audit per-file and third-party dependency rights.

construction_gates: Qualify frozen-source dependencies and the full original brain-wide reproduction pool.
Join paper-vintage recordings and animal identities across raw sources.
Qualify the complete reference and tolerance policy.
Pin the exact three feature names, definitions, lawful covariates and numerical transforms.
Implement the common energy-score estimator and train-only baselines; freeze region/variance rules.
contamination_limit: Public source data and published figure targets prevent claims of demonstrated pretraining independence.
